plain: Open fighting or enmity between sides; acts of war

webster.text: The state of war between nations or states; the actions of an open enemy; aggression; attacks of an enemy.

example.quote: For if any one state could counteract any treaty, how could the United States avoid hostility with foreign nations?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
